description.zh:
主叫侧放音编码，固话AXB隐私号业务时必须设置。必须包含3个场景的编码。按照“B->X,A->X,其他号码->X”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

> “1,2,3”表示B->X放音编号为1，A->X放音编号为2，其他号码->X放音编号为3。
description.en:
Caller-side ringback tone code. Must be set for fixed-line AXB privacy number business. Must contain codes for 3 scenarios. Fill in the codes in the order of "B->X, A->X, Other numbers->X", separated by commas.

> "1,2,3" means the ringback tone code for B->X is 1, for A->X is 2, and for other numbers->X is 3.

description.zh:
接通后被叫侧放音编码，必须包含2个场景的编码。按照“A被叫,B被叫”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

> “1,2”表示A号码为被叫侧接听时的放音编号为1，B号码为被叫侧接听时的放音编号为2。
description.en:
Post-connection callee-side ringback tone code. Must contain codes for 2 scenarios. Fill in the codes in the order of "A as callee, B as callee", separated by commas.

> "1,2" means the ringback tone code when A answers as the callee is 1, and when B answers as the callee is 2.

description.zh: 区号。支持指定X号码归属地（指定城市->省会->全国路由）。不指定归属地，全国随机。
description.en: Area code. Supports specifying the X number's region (specified city -> provincial capital -> nationwide routing). If no region is specified, a nationwide random number is assigned.

description.zh:
绑定类型，取值：

- mode101：客户指定X号码。

- mode102：平台分配X号码。
description.en:
Binding type. Valid values:

- mode101: Customer specifies the X number.

- mode102: Platform allocates the X number.

description.zh:
过期时间，单位：秒，取值：

- 0：永不过期。

- 其他数值：传其它数值时，比如60s，分配X号码成功的60秒内，绑定有效，超过60s后，自动解绑。
description.en:
Expiration time, unit: seconds. Valid values:

- 0: Never expires.

- Other values: When other values are specified, for example 60s, the binding is valid for 60 seconds after the X number is successfully assigned. After 60 seconds, it is automatically unbound.
Unique identifier for the message request.

description.zh: 外部业务扩展字段，通话记录回执消息中会回传此参数。不能超过100个字符长度。
description.en: External business extension field. This parameter will be returned in the call record receipt message. Must not exceed 100 characters in length.

description.zh: 绑定时间，格式为yyyyMMddHHmmss。时间采用北京时间，24小时制。
description.en: Binding time, in the format yyyyMMddHHmmss. The time uses Beijing time, 24-hour clock.

description.zh:
接通后主叫侧的放音编码，必须包含2个场景的编码。按照“A被叫,B被叫”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

> “1,2”表示A号码为被叫时主叫侧的放音编号为1，B号码为被叫时主叫侧的放音编号为2。
description.en:
Post-connection caller-side ringback tone code. Must contain codes for 2 scenarios. Fill in the codes in the order of "A as callee, B as callee", separated by commas.

> "1,2" means the caller-side ringback tone code when A is the callee is 1, and when B is the callee is 2.

description.zh:
固话AXB隐私号的A号码。

> - A号码可设置为手机号码或固定电话，固定电话请加区号，区号和固定电话之间不需要连字符。 
>- 如果您的业务需要修改已绑定的号码，可以调用[UpdateAxbBindFixedLine](~~2883050~~)接口进行修改。
description.en:
The A number in the fixed-line AXB privacy number.

> - The A number can be set to a mobile phone number or a landline number. For landline numbers, include the area code. No hyphen is needed between the area code and the landline number.
>- If your business needs to modify a bound number, you can call the [UpdateAxbBindFixedLine](~~2883050~~) API to make changes.

description.zh:
固话AXB隐私号的B号码。

> - B号码可设置为手机号码或固定电话，固定电话请加区号，区号和固定电话中间不需要连字符。
> - 如果您的业务需要修改已绑定的号码，可以调用[UpdateAxbBindFixedLine](~~2883050~~)接口进行修改。
description.en:
The B number in the fixed-line AXB privacy number.

> - The B number can be set to a mobile phone number or a landline number. For landline numbers, include the area code. No hyphen is needed between the area code and the landline number.
> - If your business needs to modify a bound number, you can call the [UpdateAxbBindFixedLine](~~2883050~~) API to make changes.

description.zh:
固话AXB隐私号的X号码。X号码是您在控制台已[购买的隐私号](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/numberbuy)。

>  客户指定X号码模式下（即BindType参数为mode101），本参数必填。
description.en:
The X number in the fixed-line AXB privacy number. The X number is a privacy number you have [purchased in the console](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/numberbuy).

> In the customer-specified X number mode (i.e., the BindType parameter is mode101), this parameter is required.

description.zh: 业务时间戳，格式：yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS，时间采用北京时间，24小时制，精确至毫秒。
description.en: Business timestamp, in the format yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS. The time uses Beijing time, 24-hour clock, accurate to milliseconds.

title.en: BindAxbFixedLine - Bind Numbers for Fixed-Line AXB Privacy Number

descriptions.zh:
- 在调用此接口前，请确保您已在控制台购买隐私号。您可以使用此接口给固话AXB中间号绑定号码，暂时不支持控制台号码管理页面给固话AXB中间号绑定A、B号码。

- 绑定号码前建议您先明确业务场景中的A角色和B角色。例如：在打车应用场景中，A是乘客角色，B是司机角色。

- 固话AXB中间号主要应用在1对1场景下的隐私保护，把A号码和B号码通过号码隐私服务实现绑定关系，A拨打X转接到B，B拨打X转接到A。一个固话X号码可以供N对绑定关系复用，如A1XB1、A2XB2、A3XB3......，只要A、B用户手机号码不重复，一个固话X号码可同时绑定N组手机号码，通话也可以同时进行。

- 号码复用次数根据您购买的号码有所不同，具体复用次数可以在号码购买时与您的技术支持确认。
descriptions.en:
- Before calling this API, make sure you have purchased privacy numbers in the console. You can use this API to bind numbers to a fixed-line AXB intermediate number. Binding A and B numbers to a fixed-line AXB intermediate number through the console number management page is currently not supported.

- Before binding numbers, we recommend that you first clarify the A role and B role in your business scenario. For example, in a ride-hailing application scenario, A is the passenger role and B is the driver role.

- The fixed-line AXB intermediate number is mainly used for privacy protection in one-to-one scenarios. It binds the A number and B number through the Phone Number Protection service, so that when A calls X, the call is forwarded to B, and when B calls X, the call is forwarded to A. A single fixed-line X number can be reused for N binding relationships, such as A1XB1, A2XB2, A3XB3, and so on. As long as the A and B mobile phone numbers are not duplicated, a single fixed-line X number can simultaneously bind N groups of phone numbers, and calls can also proceed simultaneously.

- The number of reuse times varies depending on the number you purchased. The specific number of reuse times can be confirmed with your technical support when purchasing the number.
